versions.content: When processing a diagnostic request, the Dcm module shall reject ( Dcm_StartOfReception shall return BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK) any new diag- nostic request with the same DcmDslConnection until the current diagnostic re- quest processing is over. Concurrent TesterPresent requests will be accepted with a BUFREQ_OK, but not further processed, as the running diagnostic request already resets the session timeout timer (S3Server).
